product.name: Monoprice Select Series Mini DisplayPort 1.2a to HDTV 4K Capable Cable 6ft
product.description: The Select Series Mini DisplayPort® / Mini DisplayPort 1.2a to HDTV 4K Capable Cable allows you to connect your DisplayPort-enabled computer to an HDTV 4K display or other HDMI® ready device. This DisplayPort 1.2a compliant cable is up to twice as fast as DisplayPort 1.1 and is backwards compatible.                                            Mini DisplayPort 1.2a / HDTV 4K Capable Cable                                                                                                                                                            Twice as Fast                          Displayport 1.2a Compliant                          HDTV 4K                                              Twice as Fast: DisplayPort® 1.2a is up to twice as fast as DisplayPort 1.1, transmitting both audio and video from computers or tablets to an HDTV display. It supports video resolutions up to 3840 x 2160 4K UHD, plus flawless audio pass-through for uncompressed digital audio with 7.1, 5.1, or 2 channels.                    DisplayPort 1.2a Compliant: Compliant with the DisplayPort 1.2a specification, this cable is also backwards compatible with DisplayPort 1.1/1.1a. Supporting data speeds up to 21.6Gbps, this cable transmits uncompressed audio and deep color depth twice as fast as the previous specification.                    HDTV 4K: Broad compatibility with computers, phones, and tablets with DisplayPort or Mini DisplayPort video output and high-resolution HDMI® enabled displays.
